figures.notes: Real freya CHIME: model overlays band-summed data through the full scattering-tail decay (~17-25 ms); red_chi2=1.18, dw=1.27, beta=3.683 on panel (red_chi2 matches Route B's PPC 1.18). Honest blemishes: one ~-3sigma residual excursion at the peak (~17.5 ms) and Q-Q tail scatter beyond +/-3sigma (extreme quantiles reach ~+6/-7); bulk hugs y=x. On-pulse fine structure at band-summed scale, consistent with dw<1.5; #111 validation PASS with no marginals.

Real freya DSA: near-unresolved ~0.3 ms pulse cleanly overlaid; red_chi2=1.03, dw=1.41, beta=3.683 on panel (matches Route B PPC 1.03); residuals structureless across the 31 ms window; Q-Q hugs y=x with a single ~-5sigma extreme point.

Model overlays band-summed data through the scattering tail (peak ~4 ms, tail to ~10 ms); residuals structureless around zero across the 32 ms window; Q-Q of noise-normalized residuals hugs y=x with only mild extreme-tail scatter; red_chi2=0.99, dw=1.87 on panel.
Narrow ~1 ms burst; model overlays data; residuals structureless over the 6 ms window; Q-Q hugs y=x; red_chi2=1.00, dw=2.09 on panel.
